ios.desc:
Does your toddler love animals AND vehicles? Baby's First Cards brings both to life – with real sounds, real photos, bilingual audio, and colors you control.
﻿
WHAT MAKES BABY'S FIRST CARDS DIFFERENT?
﻿
BILINGUAL + NATIVE PRONUNCIATION
English or Chinese? Both! Every card includes professional, native-speaker voiceovers in both languages. Perfect for bilingual families, language learners, or just exposing your child to a second language early.
﻿
REAL ANIMAL & VEHICLE SOUNDS
From cows mooing and cats meowing to fire trucks wailing and trains chugging. Tap once – hear the sound. Tap again – hear the word. Every card comes alive.
﻿
REAL PHOTOS – NO CARTOONS
Your child learns to recognize the real world. Every card uses high-quality, realistic images – just like physical flashcards.
﻿
CUSTOM BACKGROUND COLORS
You choose! Pick the perfect background for each card. Light for daytime reading. Dark for bedtime. Whatever helps your child focus
﻿
PERFECT FOR TODDLERS (ages 1-5)
- Large buttons – easy for little fingers
- Simple tap – hear the word in English or Chinese
- No reading required – just look, listen, and learn
﻿
PARENTS LOVE IT
100% ad-free – no pop-ups, no distractions
Works offline – no Wi-Fi needed
One-time purchase – unlock everything, forever. No subscriptions.
No data collection – your child's privacy is protected
Bilingual – great for 双语家庭 or learning a new language
﻿
USE IT ANYWHERE
- Quiet time at home
- Long car rides
- Waiting rooms
- Airplane mode travel
- Bedtime wind-down
﻿
The Ultimate Custom Cards
Want an app that only shows YOUR cat, YOUR car, YOUR family?
Delete every built-in card (restore anytime) and build your child‘s world from scratch. Take your own photos. Record your own voice. Create a truly one-of-a-kind learning set — as unique as your family.
Plus, iCloud backup means your custom cards move with you. Get a new phone? They’re all there. No setup. No loss. Just seamless.

Designed with love for little hands and curious minds. Download Baby's First Cards today – and watch your child moo, vroom, and learn in two languages!
﻿
PRIVACY & SAFETY
No ads. No tracking. No subscriptions. Just a safe, simple bilingual learning tool for your child.

quotes.text:
App maker here. I built this because most flash card apps use cartoonish illustrations that don't help babies recognize real objects.
This app lets you take photos of real things around the house or pick from curated real photo sets.

Key features: • Take your own photos as flash cards • Record your own voice for each card • Pre-loaded kits with high-quality real photos and real animal sounds • Bilingual (English and Chinese) mode • Fully offline, no ads, no data collection • One-time purchase, no subscription

Happy to answer questions or discuss the development process!
